mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 2%, it signals a tight labor market that will put upward pressure on wages and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y PAYEMS growth > 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) rises by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a supply-constrained economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth > 5% and UNRATE < 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) declines for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is also rising.
failure_condition: GDPC1 declines for 2 quarters but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances, or the signal is not significantly more negative when UNRATE is also rising.
